scenicChapters.title: Dolomiti di Brenta → Fiavé-Lago Carera
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 27 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Vivione
scenicChapters.narrative: 28 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Bieszczady Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Bieszczady Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-stuzica-bukovske-vrchy-ruska-byst.story: It goes by way of Rožok, Ruská Bystrá and back through Rožok. It crosses Poland, Ukraine and Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
